column1: # Shared arithmetic fixtures for rush and nexus-rush (design review
# Tranche 4: shared test fixtures, not code). Each crate runs every case
# against its own arith::eval; both must agree with bash $(( )).
# Integer division and remainder truncate toward zero
# && and || short-circuit: the right side is not evaluated
# ...but it is still parsed: a syntax error there is an error
